svg.title: Estimated effects of adopting AI coding agents
svg.desc: Lines of code +44.0%, commits +36.0%, pull requests +35.7%; Jira issues resolved +13.7% (borderline significant), epics +18.0%; time from submission to approval +56.1%, backlog wait +59.9%, active review +58.5%, comments per pull request +38.6%.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: More code went in. Review got slower.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Estimated change after firms adopted AI coding agents, on top of AI assistants. 655 firms, 720,542 workers.
